rounds: Everyone should carry some cash, in case card payments stop working.
Most celebrity apologies on Instagram are written by their PR team.
I'd forgive a company's mistake faster if its reply made me laugh.
I've bought things by card that I'd never have bought with cash.
News sites should never report a rumour until it has been confirmed.
If my train is two hours late, a free coffee makes up for it.
People forget a company's scandal within a year.
I'd stop buying a brand I love if it was caught lying.
